decision: The reported search/filter vertical dead-space regression is closed at 390x844, 536x864 and 1280x720. Remaining space is proportional container rhythm or a functional horizontal-scroll affordance, not an empty row.

evidence: The real input is vertically centered inside the search outer: 390 top/bottom inset 1.031/1.047px, 536 1.422/1.422px, desktop 1/1px.
The search wrapper has no hidden bottom padding. Its top breathing room is balanced by the following section gap: 390 18.719px versus 14.547px; 536 25.719px versus 20px; desktop 18px versus 14px.
Search outer uses align-items:center and the input has zero block padding, so the previous phantom lower line-box is absent.

The environment rail is one control row plus the deliberate scrollbar lane: chip bottom inset 10.406px at 390 and 14.281px at 536; it is 0 at desktop where the controls wrap and scrolling is disabled.
The rail has no partial initial chip at either mobile width and no vertical overflow.

Vertical wheel input over the rail moves scrollLeft from 0 to 500; focus and pointer selection also scroll the target fully into view. The right-edge continuation marker is visible on the narrow render.
Panel content-bottom gap is 11.391px at 390, 15.281px at 536 and 11px desktop, matching the panel's declared bottom padding rather than creating an additional row.

controlGeometry.evidence: Line height, box height and vertical alignment are stable. Mobile environment controls occupy one 44px-equivalent row; desktop controls wrap without a scroll gutter.

evidence: All 39 environment choices are focusable, role=button, have aria-pressed, and become fully visible when focused.
All 3 category choices also pass, for 42/42 total filter controls.
Pointer, Enter and Space each change the final environment option from aria-pressed=false to true with focus retained.
Vertical wheel/trackpad motion is usable as horizontal scrolling; direct horizontal delta is browser-dependent and did not move in headless Chrome, but this does not block the ordinary wheel path.

foldAndOverflow.evidence: Season strip and first deck card are visible in all three initial viewports. Document horizontal overflow is 0px in every viewport.

businessSafety.evidence: No POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE request was observed during render, focus, pointer or keyboard probes.

regression.evidence: Build, mine, event, round and detail fresh mobile screenshots exactly match Attempt 4 SHA-256 values and each has 0px document overflow.

directionPreservation.evidence: Attempt 4's warm-paper editorial direction, low-radius cards, navy/red hierarchy and restrained yellow active state remain intact on Plaza.
